title: deepFreeze lives in its own leaf module
answers: Why doesn't utils.tsx export deepFreeze anymore?
body: deepFreeze was moved out of public/app/features/plugins/extensions/utils.tsx into public/app/features/plugins/extensions/deepFreeze.ts as a standalone leaf module (no external deps), used by Registry.ts to break an eager import cycle through utils.tsx. Import it from './deepFreeze', not './utils'.
applies: public/app/features/plugins/extensions/registry/** and any code needing deep object freezing
